_why: Skill-candidates row 'run the full project suite on the MERGED tree': a test passed on the branch and failed on merged main because the base had moved. 7f only printed 're-run the suite'. `--suite` now runs it on a NEW merged tree and the MERGED token carries the result; these rows prove each state has a test that bites.

mutations.name: a-red-merged-suite-reads-pass
mutations._mechanism: The suite's exit code is ignored, so a red merged tree is pushed as PASS.
mutations.find: suite = f"suite={'PASS' if rc == 0 else 'FAIL'} rc={rc}"

mutations.name: no-suite-reads-covered
mutations._mechanism: A new merged tree with no command given claims coverage it does not have.

mutations.name: an-identical-tree-re-runs-the-suite
mutations._mechanism: identity=y re-runs eight minutes of suite the existing run already covers by proof.

mutations.name: the-suite-runs-outside-the-merged-tree
mutations._mechanism: The command runs in the caller's cwd, not the repo, so it tests whatever tree the caller happens to be in.
